newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Pepkor lifts interim shr.
newsitem.headline: Pepkor lifts interim shr.

text.p: NOTE - The group said that it expected positive trading patterns to continue and that earnings would show a higher growth in the second half of the year.

It forecast that the total dividend for the year would be about 44 cents compared to the 40 cents for the previous year. It had to be remembered, however, that because of a change in year end, the reporting period would cover 16 months.
The dividend will be confirmed at the end of March as the group wants to wait until after the March 12 budget to see whether the payment of secondary tax on companies would be affected in any way.
The exceptional items represent income from the sale of 10 percent of its interest in Smart Holdings and profits from the sale of land and buildings.
